question:
**Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.**

A fictional being from another world
solution:
The correct answer is '**Alien**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate word for the given group of words is '**Alien**'.
 
• It means 'a person who comes from another country'. (विदेशी व्‍यक्ति)
 
 
• *Example: It is **alien** to the school discipline.*

 
 
 

**Correct Answer:__** *Alien.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

 
• Let's look at the meaning of other words:
 
 
• **Stranger**: a person that you do not know. (अपरिचित व्‍यक्ति, अजनबी )
 
• **Native**: connected with the place where you were born or where you have always lived. (जन्‍म स्‍थान या निवास-स्‍थान से संबंधित)
 
• **Foreigner**: a person who belongs to a country that is not your own. (आपने देश से भिन्‍न देश का निवासी; विदेशी व्‍यक्ति)
